skills.notes: Nested `.claude/skills/` below the working directory are read too (a monorepo package's own skills); `/skill-name` invokes one directly.

notes: Frontmatter verified against the current docs: name, description, tools, disallowedTools, model (sonnet/opus/haiku/fable/full id/inherit), effort (low…max), and more. Project agents live in .claude/agents/ and are meant to be committed. `instructions` lists .claude/CLAUDE.md first: a project that keeps its rules there (a common layout) would otherwise never receive the routing block, since the block only goes into instruction files that exist.
